title: The US and Pax Silica allies, including Japan, the UK, and India, agree to create a joint list of AI technologies and supply chains to protect from China (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: The US and Pax Silica allies, including Japan, the UK, and India, agree to create a joint list of AI technologies and supply chains to protect from China — Pact comes ahead of Donald Trump's meeting with Xi Jinping at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in Shenzhen
